policy.canonical_redirect_image_inheritance: retired duplicate image is inherited by its surviving canonical unless that target owns a direct formal image

rows.reason: A service access door is a visually identifiable installed component; a subject-matched photograph materially helps distinguish it from a simple opening or panel.
An access panel has a stable visible form as an openable wall or ceiling component; a reviewed photograph improves recognition.
Acoustic panels are physical finish products with recognizable installed forms; a representative subject-matched photograph aids identification.
An adhesion test has a recognizable field setup such as bonded test dollies and pull-off equipment; a reviewed process photograph can explain the canonical without being arbitrary.

Carry forward existing formal-image decision from image-wave4-sources-v2.3.json (allen_key); no new independent review. Existing subject review: Commons describes an assortment of metric Allen keys and structured data identifies the depicted subject as hex keys; direct match for allen_key.
An anchor bolt is a concrete fastening component with a distinct physical form and installation context; a verified photograph is useful for identification.
A plastic wall plug is a visually identifiable fastener; a close subject-matched photograph would materially aid recognition.
An angle finder is a distinct measuring tool with recognizable forms; a reviewed tool photograph is appropriate.
